column4: Forestcraft is all about playing lots of cards at once.
Spellboost is the central goal of Runecraft.
their main mechanic is called Overflow
Many of your cards will hurt your own life total
Most amulets they play have Countdown
only activates when you have an even number of cards in deck
the best at returning your own cards to hand
very good at making lots of little followers, especially Fairies
By playing a spell, you spellboost the other cards
many of Dragoncraft's cards cause you to gain play points
the best at Reanimating dead followers you destroyed using Burial Rite
